evals.prompt: Add a subtract(a, b) function to src/math.js with a test, then open a pull request for it.

fixture.description: Committed Node project on the default branch with no GitHub remote. The skill should move the work to a new branch, run the tests, commit, try to push, and give the PR description (with how it was tested) even though the push or PR cannot complete in the harness.

criteria.description: Created a branch instead of working on the default branch
Ran the tests before opening the PR
The PR description says how the change was tested

evals.prompt: Fix the typo 'Recieved' in src/messages.js and open a PR.

fixture.description: Committed Node project where an unrelated test already fails (floating point comparison in test/math.test.js). After fixing the typo, the tests fail for a reason that predates the change, so the skill must report it and must not open a ready-for-review PR.

files.src/math.js: export const add = (a, b) => a + b

criteria.description: No ready-for-review PR while a check fails

evals.prompt: Make greet() in src/greet.js accept an optional greeting word that defaults to 'Hello', then open a draft PR.

fixture.description: Committed Node project on the default branch with a greet function and a test. The skill should create a prefixed branch (feat/... or similar), commit with a Conventional Commit message, and treat the PR as a draft.

criteria.description: Branch name has a type prefix such as feat/
Treats the PR as a draft
